name: Andean Consolidated
trade: Bulk ore and refined metals from Andean Consolidated yards.
description: AC is a vast resource and infrastructure conglomerate descended from the great Latino mining, agricultural and industrial enterprises. Its interests span mining, energy, agriculture, manufacturing, construction and transportation, with particular strength in planetary resource extraction. Andean's expertise in operating across difficult terrain has made it a major force in frontier development throughout human space.

name: Atlas Concern
trade: Atlas Concern life-support and habitat systems for long tours.
description: Atlas Concern is a vast industrial and infrastructure conglomerate with interests in mining, construction, energy, transportation and planetary development. It specialises in projects too large, remote or difficult for most corporations to undertake, from deep-space extraction to entire cities and orbital facilities. Its immense engineering capacity and appetite for expansion have made Atlas indispensable to the growth of human space.

name: BioGenesis Life Sciences
trade: BioGenesis certified biologics and containment for regulated trade.
description: BioGenesis Life Sciences is a major pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporation with interests spanning medicine, genetics, reproductive technology and advanced biological research. Its products range from everyday pharmaceuticals to sophisticated therapies and engineered biological systems. BioGenesis operates extensive research facilities throughout human space and maintains a particularly strong position in treatments designed to extend, enhance and restore human life.

name: Carthage Mercantile
trade: Carthage Mercantile moves cargo where margins justify the risk.
description: Carthage Mercantile traces its lineage to Mediterranean trading houses that survived through centuries of political upheaval by continually reinventing themselves. Today it is a sprawling conglomerate spanning shipping, finance, commodities, agriculture, luxury goods and communications. Its executives maintain an almost obsessive interest in trade routes and commercial intelligence.

name: Chettiar Holdings
trade: Chettiar Holdings - structured finance across the inner systems.
description: Chettiar Holdings traces its origins to the Indo merchant-banking communities of Old Earth. Today it is a diversified conglomerate with major interests in finance, commodities, property, shipping, manufacturing and infrastructure. Its extensive networking and reputation for careful stewardship have made Chettiar one of the galaxy’s most enduring commercial institutions.

name: Chimera Corporation
trade: Chimera Corporation security contracts and licensed enforcement.
description: Chimera began as an eccentric research enterprise and now owns an extraordinary portfolio of biotechnology, artificial intelligence, entertainment, pharmaceuticals and experimental technologies, with a sideline in theme parks, contracting and software. There is not always a clear distinction between its commercial and scientific ambitions.

name: Continuity Foundation
trade: Continuity Foundation preserves infrastructure others neglect.
description: The Continuity Foundation has enterprises in education, healthcare, biotechnology, archives, infrastructure and long-term planetary development. It maintains enormous libraries, genetic repositories and cultural archives throughout human space, while its investment and development arms give it considerable influence over the future of entire worlds.

name: Creus Corporation
trade: Creus Corporation banking and escrow for interstellar commerce.
description: Creus is an old and respected investment bank and one of the richest corporations out there, at least in terms of declared assets. Their core banking operations are under threat from the upstart GRC, but they still hold the monopoly when it comes to auction houses, micro loans and property markets. By virtue of hundreds of years of private equity activity they operate a diverse portfolio of seemingly business units.

name: Crown & Anchor
trade: Crown & Anchor - insured freight and charter brokerage.
description: Crown & Anchor is an old and enormously wealthy corporation with deep roots in shipping, insurance and maritime commerce. Today it operates across finance, transportation, property, hospitality and infrastructure, with particular strength in ports, orbital docks and long-distance logistics. Its conservative culture and distinctive old-world branding conceal a highly sophisticated and aggressively expanding commercial empire.

name: Fellowship of Apex
trade: The Fellowship of Apex. Join us threading the needle of infinity.
description: The Fellowship traces its origins to a late twenty-first-century hacker and religious radical who died after hijacking a NASA launch and sending his writings and personal effects into deep space as a time capsule. Recovered centuries later, the capsule inspired a powerful new faith whose institutions grew into a vast corporate empire.

name: Dar al-Nour Trust
trade: Dar al-Nour Trust — sharia-compliant trade finance.
description: Dar al-Nour Trust is an ancient institution descended from Islamic charitable endowments established on Old Earth. Its holdings span healthcare, education, finance, property, agriculture and infrastructure, with its wealth dedicated to maintaining institutions intended to endure indefinitely.

name: DeepSpace Cooperative
trade: DeepSpace Cooperative hauls for members who own the lanes.
description: DeepSpace Cooperative traces its origins to the first generation of humans born away from Earth. The early off-world communities pooled their resources to survive in isolated settlements, gradually developing a cooperative commercial structure that grew alongside the frontier. Today DSC is a vast diversified corporation owned collectively by its members, with interests spanning mining, shipping, aerospace, manufacturing, finance and planetary development.

name: Evergreen Group
trade: Evergreen Group modules and spares with same-day habitat delivery.
description: Evergreen Group is a diversified corporation built around agriculture, natural resources and environmental services. Its interests span food production, forestry, energy, water management, biotechnology and planetary development. Evergreen controls extensive tracts of productive land and has become a major provider of the resources required to sustain growing populations, giving it considerable influence over both established worlds and the frontier.

name: Four Rivers Zaibatsu
trade: Four Rivers Zaibatsu industrial output for heavy industry.
description: Four Rivers Zaibatsu is an ancient Japanese conglomerate descended from one of the great industrial families of Old Earth. Its interests span banking, manufacturing, energy, shipping, technology and consumer goods, with a network of subsidiary companies bound together by generations of family ownership and corporate tradition. The Zaibatsu remains notoriously private, conservative and exceptionally difficult for outsiders to influence.

name: Galactic Outcomes
trade: Galactic Outcomes - extraction and salvage, no apologies.
description: Galactic Outcomes has its roots in the turbulent African politics of the late twentieth and early twenty-first century. The company began by supplying local mercenaries to the highest bidder, a lucrative market at the time. Today they are by far the largest supplier of all forms of hired muscle from bouncers and bodyguards to soldiers and assassins. They include a profitable subdivision that manufactures all forms of small arms and ammunition for both the personal and corporate market, and another that specialises in non-combat personnel like scientists, engineers and accountants.

name: General Industrial
trade: General Industrial: mass-produced modules that keep fleets flying.
description: GI is a conglomerate whose interests extend across manufacturing, energy, mining, construction, logistics and infrastructure. Its corporate philosophy is brutally simple: own the things everyone else needs. General Industrial has little public identity beyond its deliberately anonymous name, but its subsidiaries are embedded throughout the galactic economy, giving it extraordinary reach and leverage.

name: GRC Inc
trade: GRC Inc — corporate treasury and settlement rails.
description: GRC is the youngest of the large corporations, and it is in direct competition with the older and larger Creus Corp. Both corporations deal in the investment banking and speculation market. GRC sprang into being a mere two generations ago when an uncharacteristic slip by Creus left the market wide open for a competitor.

name: Greenfields Corporation
trade: Greenfields Corporation agri-tech and fresh provisions.
description: Greenfields Corporation is an agricultural and food conglomerate, controlling extensive interests in farming, livestock, food processing, biotechnology, water management and distribution. Its operations range from vast automated plantations to food brands found throughout human space. Greenfields is particularly influential on populous worlds, where its supply networks feed billions of people every day.

name: Guangzhou Mercantile
trade: Guangzhou Mercantile consolidates Pacific Rim freight.
description: Guangzhou Mercantile traces its origins to the great Sino merchant houses, whose fortunes were built on maritime trade and long-distance commerce. Today it is a diversified corporation with major interests in shipping, finance, commodities, manufacturing, logistics and consumer goods. Its extensive trading network connects markets throughout human space, while its traditional merchant culture remains central to the company's identity.

name: Hanseatic Ltd
trade: Hanseatic Ltd - mutual credit among trusted houses.
description: Hanseatic Ltd is an ancient commercial institution descended from the Euro merchant leagues. It operates across shipping, finance, trade, warehousing and insurance, maintaining an extensive network of ports, markets and trading houses throughout human space. Its members value long-term relationships and mutual obligation, and it remains a formidable force in interplanetary commerce.

name: Himalaya Triad
trade: Himalaya Triad mining concessions and guarded convoys.
description: The corporation traces its origins to Tibetan triads that emerged in the late twenty-first century. It has extensive interests in pharmaceuticals, personal services, security, finance, resource extraction, mining, and specialist contracting and logistics. HT has a reputation in the market for decisive and occasionally ruthless business practices.

name: Holt-Winters Corp
trade: Holt-Winters Corp drives, hulls, and flight hardware.
description: Holt-Winters is a young, ambitious conglomerate with a reputation for innovation and aggressive expansion. It is a major player in energy, aerospace, electronics and advanced materials, with particularly strong positions in compact power systems and shield technology. Holt-Winters also operates extensive consumer and industrial businesses, and its light spacecraft are popular with independent operators.

name: House of Roth
trade: House of Roth private banking for serious operators.
description: House of Roth traces its origins to a network of Euro banking families whose fortunes grew alongside the great diamond, oil and mineral empires of the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. Today the House controls extensive interests in finance, energy, mining, commodities and property, combining immense inherited wealth with generations of accumulated corporate influence. It remains one of the galaxy’s great old-money institutions.

name: Karaquazen Inc
trade: Karaquazen Inc - cheerful service and dependable shipyard work.
description: Karaquazen is a corporation respected for its monopoly as much as it is feared for its methods. It runs a galactic chain of mega-casinos and gambling houses, and operates 95% of all the planetary lotteries. Although it is not widely known, Karaquazen also has a controlling interest in nearly all medical aid and insurance providers. It's diversified Operations division maintains a surprising variety of manufacturing, logistics and property interests.

name: LiveWorlds
trade: LiveWorlds entertainment and sim licences for long hauls.
description: LiveWorlds is an entertainment conglomerate specialising in live experiences, interactive media, sports, gaming, virtual reality, social media, celebrity culture, and it operates a seldom-mentioned sideline in propaganda and industrial espionage. It operates stadiums, arenas, resorts, virtual worlds and entertainment networks throughout human space, while representing many of its most famous performers and athletes. Its business is built around turning audiences into participants, and experiences into enormous recurring revenues.

name: Mercury Communications
trade: Mercury Communications keeps your manifest on the wire.
description: Mercury Communications is a dominant provider of communications infrastructure throughout human space. Its networks span planetary telecommunications, interplanetary relays, navigation systems, data services and broadcasting infrastructure, connecting corporations, habitats and billions of individuals. Mercury's immense network is effectively indispensable to modern commerce, and its reputation for reliability has made its distinctive name synonymous with communication itself.

name: The Meridian Company
trade: The Meridian Company precision instruments and nav suites.
description: TMC is a vast diversified corporation with roots in global trade, shipping and navigation. Today its interests span transportation, finance, communications, energy, infrastructure and consumer services, with operations extending across much of human space. Meridian's reputation is one of relentless expansion, and its distinctive name has become synonymous with connectivity, movement and commerce.

name: MicroDonald Franchise
trade: MicroDonald Franchise — familiar food, every habitat.
description: Born of the merger between several Americano-descended companies, MicroDonald specialises in low cost, high volume consumer goods and services of all kinds. Behind its high-powered advertising campaign and cute mascot, MDF is a cunning and ruthless monopoly that has annihilated all competition. It is possible, and increasingly common on some worlds, for a person to use exclusively MDF products from the moment he is born in an MDF governed city-mall to the day he is buried in an MDF coffin.

name: Monday Corporation
trade: Monday Corporation productivity tools for busy crews.
description: Monday Corporation began as a modest software company and grew through centuries of acquisitions into a sprawling technology and services conglomerate. Today it operates across software, communications, finance, consumer technology, entertainment and infrastructure. Its famously unremarkable name has survived every merger and rebranding campaign, becoming one of the most recognisable corporate identities in human space.

name: Morrow & Sons
trade: Morrow & Sons bespoke fittings for discerning captains.
description: Morrow & Sons began as a provider of funerary services. Its interests now extend into life insurance, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, property and cryogenic preservation. Its business begins where other corporations' responsibilities end, managing every stage of death and remembrance. Morrow maintains an immense portfolio of cemeteries, memorial habitats and long-term preservation facilities throughout human space.

name: The Octagon
trade: The Octagon - diversified holdings, single counterparty.
description: The Octagon is an opaque financial conglomerate whose origins are deliberately obscure and whose interests extend far beyond conventional banking. It operates across investment, insurance, commodities, property and corporate finance, with a vast network of subsidiaries and holdings.

name: Oklahoma Combine
trade: Oklahoma Combine agri bulk and fuel derivatives.
description: The Oklahoma Combine began as a consortium of Americano agricultural, energy and engineering firms. It is a major supplier of industrial machinery, spacecraft and infrastructure. The Combine retains a reputation for practicality, reliability and formidable logistical capacity.

name: Orion Aerospace
trade: Orion Aerospace frames and thrusters built for workhorse fleets.
description: Orion Aerospace is one of the galaxy's dominant spacecraft manufacturers, producing everything from small private vessels to enormous commercial and industrial ships. Its interests extend into propulsion, avionics, shipyards, aerospace engineering and orbital infrastructure. Orion's ships are known for reliability and longevity, and its extensive network of yards and service facilities supports fleets throughout human space.

name: Orion Spur Company
trade: Orion Spur Company passenger services along the spur routes.
description: OSC is an ancient trading corporation whose origins lie in the beginnings of commercial space travel. Over centuries it expanded into shipping, finance, resource extraction and general commerce, eventually becoming one of the largest diversified corporations in human space. The company is known for its relentless expansion and aggressive acquisition strategy, routinely entering markets where it has little previous presence and quickly establishing a challenging position.

name: Pacific Triad
trade: Pacific Triad logistics across triad ports.
description: Descended from the Sino-Americano-Hanguk criminal fraternity. Today the Triad's interests span finance, shipping, entertainment, security, pharmaceuticals and consumer goods. Its enormous commercial network is built on generations of family relationships and personal connections, and it remains one of the galaxy’s most influential corporations, particularly across the rim worlds.

name: ParaRamcoVidia
trade: ParaRamcoVidia media bundles and shipboard infotainment.
description: ParaRamcoVidia is a vast conglomerate and a dominant force in media, entertainment, energy, computing and communications, with extensive interests across manufacturing, infrastructure, consumer technology and research. Its media division controls major broadcast networks, studios and entertainment platforms, while its energy and technology divisions provide essential infrastructure throughout human space.

name: The Praetorium
trade: The Praetorium executive protection and risk mitigation.
description: The Praetorium is a provider of private security, legal services and arbitration, complemented by an extensive luxury division offering secure residences, travel, hospitality and personal services to the galaxy's most powerful clients. Their sideline in high-end weaponry and software systems is less well known.

name: Sakuraya Shinise
trade: Sakuraya Shinise refined components and ceremonial quality.
description: Sakuraya Shinise claims to be humanity’s oldest continuously operating business, originating as a small Japanese family tea shop in Nippon, Old Earth. Today it is a vast and highly diversified conglomerate with interests spanning manufacturing, finance, food, hospitality, technology and transportation. The founding family remains closely involved, and Sakuraya’s traditional culture is famously conservative despite its enormous scale.

name: Seven Bells Inc
trade: Seven Bells Inc salvage rights and recovery operations.
description: Seven Bells began as a small family manufacturer of precision bells and signaling equipment, eventually expanding into communications, electronics and industrial systems. Today it is a diversified conglomerate with major interests in communications, manufacturing, consumer technology, aerospace and infrastructure. The corporation retains a peculiar affection for its origins, and seven bells remain a prominent symbol throughout its branding.

name: SnedeCorp
trade: SnedeCorp software solutions, industrial chemicals and process equipment.
description: Software is the game of SnedeCorp. It has over time amalgamated hundreds of thousands of different software companies to gain the monopoly in the market. They manufacture all kinds of software from games to commercial software to the complex systems found on modern space ships. SnedeCorp has a reputation as a paranoid and secretive company.

name: Terra Nova
trade: Terra Nova settlement packages and colonial logistics.
description: Terra Nova is a planetary resource extraction corporation specialising in mining, agriculture and environmental engineering. It operates mines, industrial plantations and genetically engineered food systems, alongside water extraction, forestry and terraforming. Terra Nova's philosophy is simple: a planet is a resource to be optimised, and its enormous appetite for land and materials makes it a dominant force in frontier development.

name: Tukey Enterprises
trade: Tukey Enterprises aftermarket parts at yard prices.
description: Tukey Enterprises is a diversified commercial conglomerate with interests across manufacturing, logistics, technology and consumer goods. It has built its reputation by entering overlooked markets and supplying products that larger corporations consider too small or uninteresting to pursue. This opportunistic strategy has made Tukey a surprisingly influential supplier across human space, with a broad and constantly changing portfolio.

name: Universal House
trade: Universal House retail and ship chandlery under one roof.
description: Universal House is a sprawling consumer and commercial conglomerate with interests in retail, hospitality, food, entertainment, property and household goods. Its businesses range from enormous city malls and hotel complexes to everyday products found in homes across human space. Universal House has built its reputation on convenience, scale and an uncanny ability to make almost anything into a franchise.
